Ya zahra ya zahra
Ya zahra ya zahra

1
Zulm ye kaysa hua

2
Ghar payambar ka luta

3
Tashna lab bache the
Darya ke kanare bibi
Jin pe rote rahe
Tasnim ke dhare bibi
Thi badi garm hava

4
Al atash ki thi sada

5
Unko pani na mila

6
So gaya haye teri
God ka pala ran me
Lut gayi ale payambar
Ki kamayi ban me
Zulm mehma pe hua

7
Jism tiro pe raha

8
Lasha pamal hua

9
Zulm vo ale payambar
Pe hua jungal me
Khun me dub gaye
Lalo gohar maqtal me
Asman rota raha

10
Khun pyason ka baha

11
Shad the ahle jafa

12
Kon sunta tha vaha
Tashna labo ki faryad
Ahle ki dhate the har
Ek qadam pe bedad
Thi yatimon ki sada

13
Har taraf aho buka

14
Lut gayi ale eba

15
Kat gaye hath alamdar
Ke darya ke qarib
Dasht me ruth gaya
Pyas ke maron ka nasib
Ran me mashkiza chida

16
Gurz ek sar pe laga

17
Lawt ke aa na saka

18
Chand se sine pe
Barchi ali akbar ke lagi
Gam se bete ke shahe
Din ki qamar tut gayi
Arsh is gam se hila

19
Rote the shahe huda

20
Khun reti pe baha

21
Hurmula ne wo sitam
Tashna dahan par dhaya
Kanpi maqtal ki zamin
Awr falak tharraya
Tir gardan pe laga

22
Royi darya ki hava

23
Gam me dubi thi faza

24
Mar gaye zainabe
Muztar ke dulare bache
Haye kis umr me dunia
Se sidhare bache
Ayi gurbat me qaza

25
Ma ne shukva na kiya

26
Kar diye shah pe fida

27
Kitna dushvar tha
Bimar musafir ka safar
Nange sar bibiyan awr
Sham ki wo rah guzar
Khun chalo se risa

28
Har sitam us ne saha

29
Lab pe tha shukre khuda

30

Jayen ayazo raqim
Zikre sarvar ka sila
Payen ayazo raqim
Har ghadi hay ye dua

31
Hay yahi dil ki sada

32

metadata = metadata.replace('language:', 'alternateTitle: \"Ya Zahra Ya Zahra\"\\nlanguage:', 1).replace('direction: \"ltr\"', 'direction: \"rtl\"').replace('tags: [\"noUrdu\"]', 'tags: []')
roman_yaml = '\\n'.join('  ' + line if line else '' for line in roman.splitlines())
result = f'---{metadata}romanLyrics: |-\\n{roman_yaml}\\n---\\n\\n{source}\\n'
_, updated_metadata, updated_body = result.split('---', 2)
saved_roman = '\\n'.join(line[2:] if line else '' for line in updated_metadata.split('romanLyrics: |-\\n', 1)[1].splitlines())
assert saved_roman == roman
roman_blocks = roman.split('\\n\\n')
source_blocks = updated_body.strip().split('\\n\\n')
assert len(roman_blocks) == len(source_blocks) == 33
for i, (original, reconstructed) in enumerate(zip(roman_blocks, source_blocks)):
    assert len(original.splitlines()) == len(reconstructed.splitlines()), i
    if i:
        assert reconstructed.splitlines()[0] == str(i).translate(str.maketrans('0123456789', '۰۱۲۳۴۵۶۷۸۹'))
p.write_text(result)
print(f'Verified unchanged Roman wording and aligned opening plus {len(source_blocks)-1} stanzas.')
